items.title: Community Town Hall Meeting
items.summary: Residents are invited to a town hall meeting to discuss local priorities, public service delivery, and community development.
items.body: The campaign team will host a community town hall meeting for residents, youth representatives, traders, and community stakeholders to discuss key local issues, development priorities, and practical ways to improve governance and service delivery in Ibarapa East.
